value: **Computational & Agent-Based Modeling**: Engages students in constructing, programming, or debugging computational and agent-based simulation models to explore dynamic scientific or social phenomena. Evidence: "Emergent Systems Microworlds (ESM) are learning environments that combine agent-based approach of modeling complex emergent phenomena and constructionist design principles."
